title: CRF300L Rally
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda CRF300L Rally is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 300cc powertrain delivering 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 110 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
